Filtered Relevant Items:
1. [3] Record status/probe in case of timeout.

External Knowledge Summary:
- Status collection can omit node results when pending queries time out.
- During a network partition, node-status checks may fail to complete, causing degraded or incomplete cluster status.
- Recording timed-out checks explicitly preserves partial node status and identifies the timeout instead of silently dropping results.
